login.tagline: Study from your own notes, with sources

request.title: Reset your password

empty.body: A project holds the notes for one course.

dropZone.heading: Upload your notes to start
dropZone.body: Drop files here or <browse>browse</browse>. When a file is ready, you can ask about it and make quizzes, flashcards, and summaries.

review.roundDone_other: Round done. {{count}} mistakes still to review.

note.warning: Everything we could read is ready to study.

reason.unparseable: This file couldn't be opened. It may be damaged or password-protected.

reason.processing_failed: Reading stopped. Upload the file again.

remove.withdrawMistakes: Also remove its mistakes from my review

errors.session_expired: You've been signed out. Log in to continue.

privacyNotice.title: Before your first upload
privacyNotice.body: Study Buddy sends your files to an external AI service (through OpenRouter) to make your quizzes, flashcards, summaries, and answers. Your files are used only for your own study material, aren't shared with other users, and aren't kept by the AI service.
